conditions: An actual Finalize call invoked as part of an assignment statement propagates an exception.
limitations: This selects the stated case only. Propagation from Adjust and from finalization invoked by a master has separately specified consequences. The claim supplies no guarantee that an implementation performs every otherwise permitted-to-omit hook.
Exact unannotated Ada 2022 manual edition only. Runtime implementations and other editions require separate evidence.

triggers: Controlling edition erratum, confirmed online-to-printed discrepancy, exact artifact drift, or contrary applicable evidence.

statement: The Ada 2022 Reference Manual treats propagation from Finalize called as part of an assignment statement as a bounded error. For that invocation case, it specifies that Program_Error is raised at the point of the call.
